Definition: Salcah, a place East of the Jordan
BiblicalUsage: Salcah or Salchah = "migration"; 1) a town or district at the extreme eastern limit of Bashan and allocated to the tribe of Gad; modern 'Sulkhad' which is 56 miles (90 km) east of the Jordan at the southern extremity of the Hauran mountain range
